offering_description.value: Operates an online vehicle marketplace where shoppers compare listings and connect with dealerships and private sellers. Sells advertising, dealership websites, digital retailing software and vehicle appraisal tools to dealers and automakers. It also operates a digital wholesale auction for dealers.

primary_products.value: Dealership website software; digital vehicle retailing software; vehicle appraisal and trade-in software

primary_services.value: Consumer vehicle listings and lead generation; automotive advertising and digital marketing; dealership website development; dealer reviews and reputation management; wholesale vehicle auctions

customer_segment.value: B2B: Franchised and independent auto dealers, dealership groups, automakers and automotive advertisers; B2C: Car shoppers and private vehicle sellers using the consumer marketplace

end_markets.value: Consumer vehicle shopping; automotive retail; automotive advertising; wholesale used vehicles

revenue_model.value: subscription: Recurring dealer packages for vehicle listings, websites and dealership software; advertising: Automaker and dealer campaigns, sponsored listings and display ads; service fees: Digital marketing and campaign management for dealerships; transaction or usage fees: Fees on dealer-to-dealer wholesale vehicle sales
revenue_model.category: subscription; advertising; service fees; transaction or usage fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: Uses vehicle listings, reviews and pricing data to connect shoppers and dealers and support retail and wholesale transactions; service provider: Uses dealership inventory and campaign data to build websites and manage advertising for dealers and automakers

geography_served.value: North America: United States and Canada

specialization.value: related lines: Consumer vehicle marketplace, dealer advertising, dealership websites, retailing and appraisal software, and wholesale auctions

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Sales teams serving dealerships, dealer groups and automakers; online: Consumer marketplace website and mobile app, dealer software portals and wholesale auction platform

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Vehicle advertising and consumer lead collection are subject to FTC rules and applicable privacy laws.
